question: During which of the following years the first Five Year Plan was implemented?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951-1956.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The launching time of the **First Five-year Plan was **in **1951.** 

 
 
• It is mainly focused on the development of the primary sector.
 
• This plan was based on the** ** model naming Harrod–Domar adding with few modifications
 
• The plan was **implemented** by **Jawaharlal Nehru**, Who was **India's first Prime Minister.**
 
• The objective of this plan was to uplift the economic condition of India focusing on the parameter of improving the standard of the primary sector.
 
• In India agriculture, as it has been the most powerful source of the country's income.
